zh: 优化登录界面，支持快速填写服务地址，并可一键切换 HTTP / HTTPS 协议；新增自定义工具栏，支持工具排序与隐藏。
重构 AI 总结与 AI 设置，新增 9 个总结模板，支持多 AI 服务商与自定义模型；同时加入场景微引导、桌面快捷键与多媒体浏览翻页增强。
完善 Windows 窗口拉伸、定位、侧边栏与全部标签页体验，修复启动流程、登录探测、随机漫步与离线笔记上传时创建时间被重置等问题。
en: Refined the login screen with quicker server address entry, one-tap HTTP/HTTPS switching, and a customizable toolbar with sorting and hiding.
Reworked AI summaries and AI settings with nine new summary templates, multi-provider support, custom model settings, plus scenario onboarding and stronger desktop/media browsing shortcuts.
Improved window resizing on Windows, location tools, sidebar and tag layouts, and fixed startup flow, login detection, random walk rendering, and offline note upload timestamps.

zh: 相册选图支持原图选择
en: Gallery picking now supports original-image selection.

zh: 提升 AI 服务兼容性
en: Improved AI service compatibility.

zh: 统一编辑器、快捷输入与内联编辑的附件选择流程
抽离相机附件捕获逻辑并补足缺失文件提示
en: Unified attachment picking across the editor, quick input, and inline compose.
Extracted camera attachment capture logic and improved missing-file handling.

zh: 修复 #141 相关的媒体选择与添加问题
en: Fixed the media picking and attachment add flow behind issue #141.

zh: 抽屉菜单新增提醒角标
en: Added reminder badges to the drawer menu.

zh: 草稿箱图片增加分辨率上限
导出与本地库同步流程继续补强
en: Added resolution caps for draft images.
Further strengthened export and local-library sync flows.

zh: 修复导出不带位置信息的错误
修复备忘录关系元数据和本地关系片段未保留的问题
修复桌面子窗口同步与数据库写入问题
en: Fixed exports missing location information.
Fixed memo relation metadata and local relation fragments not being preserved.
Fixed desktop child-window sync and database write issues.

zh: 新增快捷语音输入
草稿箱支持从工具栏快速进入
本地库名称支持修改
新增通知菜单与抽屉提醒角标
en: Added quick voice input.
Drafts can now be opened directly from the toolbar.
Local library names can now be edited.
Added a notification menu and drawer badge reminders.

zh: UI 细节持续调整
优化快捷语音与语音输入界面
优化录音路由与队列同步
取消标签统一小写规范，保留原始大小写
en: Continued refining UI details.
Improved quick voice and voice input screens.
Optimized recording routing and sync queue behavior.
Removed the forced lowercase tag rule to preserve original casing.

zh: 修复附件导出异常
修复文件锁冲突
修复仅本地备忘录状态容易丢失的问题
en: Fixed attachment export failures.
Fixed file-lock conflicts.
Fixed local-only memo state getting lost.

zh: 新增局域网同步功能
搜索支持附件、定位、双链、时间筛选
新增启动方式与偏好设置
en: Added LAN sync.
Search now supports filtering by attachments, location, backlinks, and time.
Added startup mode and preference options.

zh: 优化 WebDAV 界面与同步逻辑
适配坚果云 WebDAV
优化附件上传逻辑与附件分类
调整实验室布局
优化桌面端退出程序体验
en: Improved the WebDAV UI and sync flow.
Added Nutstore WebDAV compatibility.
Optimized attachment upload logic and attachment categorization.
Adjusted the lab layout.
Refined the desktop exit experience.

zh: 修复无序列表、有序列表、待办事项工具栏无法正常插入的问题
en: Fixed the toolbar insertion issue for unordered lists, ordered lists, and todo items.

zh: 第三方分享支持直接剪藏内容
新增小红书视频剪藏
增强第三方分享剪藏，并支持清洗公众号文章
工具栏新增更多选项
笔记详情页支持双击进入编辑
en: Third-party sharing now supports direct content clipping.
Added Xiaohongshu video clipping.
Enhanced share clipping and article cleanup for WeChat content.
Added more toolbar options.
Double-tap note details to enter editing.

zh: 随机漫步补充位置信息
继续完善公众号文章清洗
优化长文阅读体验
en: Random Walk now carries location information.
Further improved article cleanup for public account content.
Optimized long-form reading.

zh: 修复图片预览黑屏故障
修复探索界面输入框无法显示的问题
防止 AI 摘要在未对齐的嵌入 blob 上崩溃
修复附件同步问题
en: Fixed the image preview black screen.
Fixed the missing input field on the Explore screen.
Prevented AI summary crashes on misaligned embedded blobs.
Fixed attachment sync issues.

zh: Windows 端支持图片压缩
en: Added image compression support on Windows.

zh: 移动端启用压缩时也可选择发送原图
附件查看界面支持按类型分类
首次握手失败时支持回退到 HTTP 重试
渲染模块解耦并补足空白行渲染
优化 Android 小组件并补充多语言支持
第三方分享可自动抓取标题并按 Markdown 填入编辑框
en: Mobile can now keep the original image even when compression is enabled.
Attachment viewing now supports type-based grouping.
The first failed handshake can now retry over HTTP.
Rendering has been decoupled and blank-line rendering is more complete.
Improved Android widgets and expanded localization support.
Shared content can now capture page titles and insert them as Markdown automatically.

zh: 随机漫步重构后支持探索笔记与 AI 总结
AI 设置新增代理配置
en: Random Walk now supports exploration notes and AI summaries.
Added proxy configuration in AI settings.

zh: AI 总结配置调整为 Chat 模型必选、向量模型可选
图片预览分辨率上限调整为 1080 像素
自动同步成功提示默认关闭
日志脱敏与文件保存路径进一步优化
en: AI summaries now require a chat model while keeping the vector model optional.
Image previews are capped at 1080px.
Auto-sync success toasts are now disabled by default.
Further improved log redaction and private app storage paths.

zh: 兼容 Memos 0.26.2 在 MySQL 下时间字段处理不一致的问题
修复 Android 10 无法构建数据库的错误
en: Fixed inconsistent MySQL timestamp handling with Memos 0.26.2.
Fixed the database creation failure on Android 10.

contents: 登录页支持快速填写地址，并可切换 HTTP / HTTPS 协议

桌面快捷键与多媒体浏览翻页增强

重构 AI 总结与 AI 设置模块

标签补充最近使用时间并支持排序

修复启动流程、登录探测与任务列表显示问题

修复离线笔记上传服务器时创建时间被重置的问题
增加分页，增强浏览时的流畅感
